message.needs_info.subject.note: Subject line of the message the merchant sends to the applicant/buyer. Formal business register.

message.needs_info.body.note: Message body the merchant copies and sends. Blank line = new paragraph. Keep the link placeholder on its own line. Formal business register.

message.needs_info.messageLine.note: Extra paragraph with the merchant message. Formal business register.

message.rejected.subject.note: Subject line of the message the merchant sends to the applicant/buyer. Formal business register.

message.rejected.body.note: Message body the merchant copies and sends. Blank line = new paragraph. Keep the link placeholder on its own line. Formal business register.

message.rejected.reasonLine.note: Extra paragraph with the merchant reason for not approving. Formal business register.

message.renewal.subject.note: Subject line of the renewal message the merchant sends a buyer (certificate without an expiry date). Formal business register.

message.approved.subject.note: Subject of the ready-made 'you're approved' message the merchant sends the buyer themselves (copy, mail app, WhatsApp).

message.approved.body.note: Body of the 'you're approved' message. {login_url} is the store's sign-in page; the buyer signs in with a one-time code Shopify emails them.
